questions.question: A grieving prophet asked, "Is there no balm in Gilead? Is no physician there?" What was he really asking about his people?

answers.text: Who will pay for the medicine
When Gilead will send its army

questions.question: A grieving prophet cried over his people and wished for something out in the wilderness. What did he wish he had?

answers.text: A traveler's lodge to leave his people
A quiet place to pray for his people
A well to bring his people water

questions.question: Because His people lied and betrayed one another, what did the LORD of Hosts say He would do to them?

answers.text: Give them a brand new king
Bring them home from far away

questions.question: After the people's lies and betrayal, the LORD said He would simply overlook what the nation had done. True or false?
